The Sacred Cadet Honor Code

"WE, THE CADETS, DO NOT LIE, CHEAT, STEAL, NOR TOLERATE AMONG US THOSE WHO DO."

The Honor Code is not a rule enforced by punishment; it is an unwritten covenant lived by every cadet in the Corps.

Core Tenet

The Non-Toleration Clause

A cadet who observes an intentional breach of the Honor Code and remains silent shares equally in the dishonor. Uphold the corps by upholding your fellow cadet's integrity.

Educational Spirit

Honor Education & Reflection

The Honor System is character-building. True honor is doing what is right even when no commanding officer or proctor is watching.
